releaseNotes:
Release v0.5.0

- Dual navigation: Google Maps stays the default, native Mappls turn-by-turn is now an Advanced option under Settings > Navigation
- Voice guidance is off by default; enable it in Settings > Navigation for spoken directions
- Mappls trips show the full upcoming-maneuvers list; the bottom nav card auto-hides when idle
- Turn pictograms fixed to match the cluster display
- Saved places fixed: Home, Work and custom spots save reliably, with a new Manage saved places screen
- Fewer API calls and throttled cluster updates to save battery and data
- Calls: incoming calls now reach the cluster
- Connect: Jupiter 125 connects even with a different Bluetooth service ID; Bluetooth scan shows only TVS scooters
- Trips: resume window default is now 15 minutes; arrival time reads Maps arrival times; cluster holds last known trip distance instead of dropping to 0
